q: Data apa yang umumnya disimpan dan dikelola dalam sistem informasi SDM (HRIS)?
o: Data karyawan, cuti, absensi, dan riwayat jabatan
e: HRIS menyimpan data induk karyawan serta cuti, absensi, dan riwayat kepegawaian di satu sistem.
q_en: What data does a human resource information system (HRIS) usually store and manage?
o_en: Employee records, leave, attendance and job history
User interface designs of company apps
e_en: An HRIS keeps employee master data plus leave, attendance and employment history in one system.

q: Apa manfaat utama menghubungkan data absensi di HRIS ke proses penggajian?
o: Mengurangi input manual dan kesalahan hitung gaji
Membuat semua karyawan mendapat gaji sama
e: Integrasi absensi ke payroll menghilangkan pengetikan ulang sehingga kesalahan perhitungan berkurang.
q_en: What is the main benefit of linking attendance data in the HRIS to payroll?
o_en: Less manual input and fewer pay calculation errors
Every employee gets the same pay
e_en: Linking attendance to payroll removes re-typing, so calculation errors fall.

q: Mengapa HRIS perlu hak akses berbasis peran?
o: Agar karyawan hanya melihat datanya sendiri dan staf HR melihat sesuai kewenangan
Agar semua orang bisa mengubah data gaji
e: Data SDM bersifat pribadi, sehingga akses dibatasi menurut peran pengguna.
q_en: Why does an HRIS need role-based access?
o_en: So employees see only their own data and HR staff see what their role allows
So everyone can edit salary data
e_en: HR data is personal, so access is limited by the user's role.

q: Seorang karyawan sudah resign tetapi statusnya di HRIS masih aktif. Risiko apa yang paling mungkin?
o: Gaji masih diproses untuk orang yang sudah keluar
e: Status yang tidak diperbarui bisa membuat payroll tetap membayar karyawan yang sudah keluar.
q_en: An employee has resigned but is still active in the HRIS. What is the most likely risk?
o_en: Pay is still processed for someone who has left
Other employees lose their leave rights
e_en: A status that is not updated can make payroll keep paying someone who has left.

q: Mana yang termasuk data induk (master data) karyawan, bukan data transaksi?
e: Data induk berubah jarang (identitas, jabatan); absensi, cuti, dan lembur adalah data transaksi yang berulang.
q_en: Which is employee master data rather than transaction data?
e_en: Master data changes rarely (identity, job title); attendance, leave and overtime are repeating transaction data.

q: Upah sejam untuk menghitung lembur karyawan bergaji bulanan diperoleh dengan membagi upah sebulan dengan angka berapa?
e: Upah sejam = 1/173 dari upah sebulan.
q_en: Hourly pay for overtime of a monthly-paid employee is found by dividing monthly pay by what number?
e_en: Hourly pay = 1/173 of monthly pay.

q: Berapa kali upah sejam yang dibayarkan untuk jam lembur pertama pada hari kerja?
e: Jam lembur pertama dibayar 1,5 kali upah sejam, jam berikutnya 2 kali.
q_en: How many times the hourly wage is paid for the first overtime hour on a working day?
e_en: The first overtime hour is paid at 1.5 times the hourly wage, later hours at 2 times.

q: Gaji sebulan Rp17.300.000. Karyawan lembur 3 jam pada hari kerja. Berapa upah lemburnya?
q_en: Monthly pay is Rp17,300,000. An employee works 3 hours of overtime on a working day. What is the overtime pay?

q: Karyawan tetap dengan masa kerja 14 bulan berhak atas THR keagamaan berapa, dan dibayar kapan?
o: 1 bulan upah, paling lambat 7 hari sebelum hari raya
Setengah bulan upah, pada hari raya
2 bulan upah, 1 bulan sebelum hari raya
1 bulan upah, seminggu setelah hari raya
e: Masa kerja 12 bulan atau lebih mendapat 1 bulan upah, dibayar paling lambat 7 hari sebelum hari raya keagamaan.
q_en: A permanent employee with 14 months of service is entitled to how much religious holiday allowance (THR), and when is it paid?
o_en: One month's wage, at the latest 7 days before the holiday
Half a month's wage, on the holiday
Two months' wages, one month before the holiday
One month's wage, a week after the holiday
e_en: Employees with 12 months or more of service get one month's wage, paid no later than 7 days before the holiday.

q: Karyawan bermasa kerja 6 bulan dengan upah Rp6.000.000 sebulan. Berapa THR proporsionalnya?
e: THR proporsional = masa kerja / 12 x 1 bulan upah = 6/12 x 6.000.000 = Rp3.000.000.
q_en: An employee with 6 months of service earns Rp6,000,000 a month. What is the proportional THR?
e_en: Proportional THR = months of service / 12 x one month's wage = 6/12 x 6,000,000 = Rp3,000,000.

q: Menurut PP 35/2021, PKWT berdasarkan jangka waktu dapat dibuat paling lama berapa tahun, termasuk perpanjangannya?
e: PKWT berdasarkan jangka waktu dibuat paling lama 5 tahun termasuk perpanjangan.
q_en: Under PP 35/2021, a fixed-term contract (PKWT) based on duration can run at most how many years, including extensions?
e_en: A duration-based PKWT can run at most 5 years including extensions.

q: Berapa lama paling lama masa percobaan untuk karyawan tetap (PKWTT)?
e: Pasal 60 UU 13/2003: masa percobaan PKWTT paling lama 3 bulan dan harus tertulis dalam perjanjian kerja.
q_en: What is the longest probation period for a permanent employee (PKWTT)?
e_en: Article 60 of Law 13/2003: probation for a PKWTT is at most 3 months and must be written in the contract.

q: Perusahaan mencantumkan masa percobaan 3 bulan dalam kontrak PKWT. Apa akibat hukumnya?
o: Masa percobaan itu batal demi hukum dan masa kerja tetap dihitung
e: Setelah UU Cipta Kerja, PKWT tidak boleh memuat masa percobaan; bila dicantumkan, batal demi hukum.
q_en: A company puts a 3-month probation in a PKWT contract. What is the legal effect?
o_en: The probation is void and the time still counts as service
It is valid because both parties agreed
It is valid if pay is halved
The contract automatically becomes a PKWTT
e_en: Since the Job Creation Law, a PKWT may not include probation; if it does, the clause is void.

q: Apa yang diterima pekerja PKWT ketika kontraknya berakhir normal?
e: Pekerja PKWT menerima uang kompensasi saat kontrak berakhir, bukan pesangon.
q_en: What does a PKWT worker receive when the contract ends normally?
e_en: A PKWT worker receives compensation money when the contract ends, not severance pay.

q: Karyawan tetap (PKWTT) terkena PHK karena efisiensi. Hak apa yang umumnya berlaku baginya?
o: Uang pesangon dan uang penghargaan masa kerja sesuai ketentuan
e: Pesangon berlaku bagi pekerja PKWTT saat terjadi PHK; besarnya menurut alasan PHK dan masa kerja.
q_en: A permanent employee (PKWTT) is terminated for efficiency reasons. Which entitlement generally applies?
o_en: Severance pay and a long-service award as regulated
e_en: Severance applies to PKWTT workers on termination; the amount depends on the reason and years of service.

q: Urutan umum proses rekrutmen yang benar adalah...
o: Sourcing, penyaringan, wawancara dan asesmen, verifikasi, penawaran
e: Kandidat dicari (sourcing), disaring, diwawancarai dan dinilai, diverifikasi latar belakangnya, lalu diberi penawaran.
q_en: The usual order of the recruitment process is...
o_en: Sourcing, screening, interview and assessment, verification, offer
e_en: Candidates are sourced, screened, interviewed and assessed, verified, and then given an offer.

q: Apa ciri wawancara terstruktur?
o: Semua kandidat mendapat pertanyaan yang sama dan dinilai dengan skala yang sama
Pertanyaan berbeda untuk setiap kandidat sesuai suasana
e: Wawancara terstruktur memakai pertanyaan dan skala penilaian yang sama untuk setiap kandidat agar adil dan dapat dibandingkan.
q_en: What marks a structured interview?
o_en: Every candidate gets the same questions and is rated on the same scale
Different questions for each candidate depending on the mood
Only the candidate's private life is discussed
e_en: A structured interview uses the same questions and rating scale for every candidate so results are fair and comparable.

q: Apa tujuan penyaringan CV pada tahap awal?
o: Memilih kandidat yang memenuhi kualifikasi minimum untuk lanjut
e: CV disaring terhadap kualifikasi minimum jabatan agar hanya kandidat yang sesuai yang lanjut ke tahap berikutnya.
q_en: What is the purpose of CV screening at the early stage?
o_en: To pick candidates who meet the minimum qualifications to move on
To fix the candidate's final salary
To reject every applicant without experience
To announce the result to the public
e_en: CVs are checked against the job's minimum qualifications so only suitable candidates move on.

q: Untuk apa organisasi memakai Applicant Tracking System (ATS)?
o: Melacak dan menyaring pelamar di seluruh tahap rekrutmen
e: ATS menyimpan data pelamar dan membantu menyaring serta melacak posisi mereka dalam proses rekrutmen.
q_en: What does an organisation use an Applicant Tracking System (ATS) for?
o_en: Tracking and screening applicants through all recruitment stages
e_en: An ATS stores applicant data and helps screen and track where each applicant stands in the process.

q: Mengapa sesi kalibrasi pewawancara berguna?
o: Menyamakan kriteria penilaian dan mengurangi bias antar pewawancara
e: Kalibrasi menyelaraskan cara pewawancara menilai sehingga hasil lebih konsisten dan bias tidak sadar berkurang.
q_en: Why are interviewer calibration sessions useful?
o_en: They align scoring criteria and reduce bias between interviewers
They speed up sending offer letters
They remove the need for interviews
e_en: Calibration aligns how interviewers score so results are more consistent and unconscious bias falls.

q: Penilaian kinerja yang adil sebaiknya menilai karyawan berdasarkan apa?
e: Karyawan harus dinilai berdasarkan fungsi esensial dan kompetensi jabatannya, yang diturunkan dari analisis jabatan.
q_en: A fair performance appraisal should rate employees on what?
o_en: The essential functions and competencies of their job
e_en: Employees should be rated on the essential functions and competencies of their job, taken from a job analysis.

q: Apa itu analisis jabatan (job analysis)?
o: Proses mengidentifikasi tugas, tanggung jawab, dan persyaratan sebuah jabatan
e: Analisis jabatan mendokumentasikan tugas, tanggung jawab, dan persyaratan jabatan, dan menjadi dasar penilaian kinerja.
q_en: What is a job analysis?
o_en: A process that identifies a job's duties, responsibilities and requirements
A supervisor's personal rating of a subordinate
e_en: A job analysis records a job's duties, responsibilities and requirements, and underpins the appraisal.

q: Apa yang dimaksud umpan balik 360 derajat?
o: Penilaian dari atasan, rekan, bawahan, dan diri sendiri
e: Umpan balik 360 derajat mengumpulkan penilaian dari berbagai sudut: atasan, rekan, bawahan, dan diri sendiri.
q_en: What is 360-degree feedback?
o_en: Ratings from supervisor, peers, subordinates and the person themselves
Ratings from the direct supervisor only
e_en: 360-degree feedback gathers ratings from many angles: supervisor, peers, subordinates and self.

q: Apa itu model kompetensi?
o: Kumpulan pengetahuan, keterampilan, dan perilaku yang dibutuhkan untuk berkinerja baik dalam suatu peran
e: Model kompetensi menyatakan pengetahuan, keterampilan, dan perilaku yang dibutuhkan agar berhasil dalam suatu peran.
q_en: What is a competency model?
o_en: The set of knowledge, skills and behaviours needed to perform well in a role
A list of pay for each job
e_en: A competency model states the knowledge, skills and behaviours needed to succeed in a role.

q: Apa tujuan kalibrasi kinerja antar manajer?
o: Menyamakan standar penilaian agar nilai konsisten antar tim
e: Kalibrasi mempertemukan manajer untuk menyelaraskan standar sehingga nilai di satu tim sebanding dengan tim lain.
q_en: What is the aim of performance calibration among managers?
o_en: To align rating standards so scores are consistent across teams
To decide who will be laid off
To replace the rating system every month
e_en: Calibration brings managers together to align standards so one team's scores are comparable to another's.

q: Apa empat level evaluasi pelatihan menurut model Kirkpatrick?
e: Empat level Kirkpatrick: reaksi, pembelajaran, perilaku, dan hasil.
q_en: What are the four levels of training evaluation in the Kirkpatrick model?
e_en: The four Kirkpatrick levels are reaction, learning, behaviour and results.

q: Pre-test dan post-test pelatihan mengukur level Kirkpatrick yang mana?
e: Level 2 mengukur pengetahuan dan keterampilan yang diperoleh, misalnya lewat pre-test dan post-test.
q_en: Which Kirkpatrick level do training pre-tests and post-tests measure?
e_en: Level 2 measures knowledge and skills gained, for example with pre-tests and post-tests.

q: Pelatihan sudah selesai. Tiga bulan kemudian atasan mengamati apakah peserta memakai keterampilan barunya di pekerjaan. Level mana ini?
e: Level 3 menilai apakah peserta menerapkan apa yang dipelajari di tempat kerja, lewat observasi atau umpan balik.
q_en: After training, three months later a supervisor observes whether participants use the new skills on the job. Which level is this?
e_en: Level 3 checks whether participants apply what they learned at work, by observation or feedback.

q: Mengapa analisis kebutuhan pelatihan (TNA) dilakukan sebelum merancang pelatihan?
o: Untuk mengetahui kesenjangan kompetensi yang perlu ditutup
e: TNA mengidentifikasi kesenjangan antara kompetensi yang ada dan yang dibutuhkan sehingga pelatihan tepat sasaran.
q_en: Why is a training needs analysis (TNA) done before designing training?
o_en: To find the competency gaps that need closing
To set the participants' final grades
e_en: A TNA finds the gap between existing and required competencies so training hits the right target.

q: Setelah program pelatihan layanan pelanggan, tingkat keluhan perusahaan turun 20%. Level Kirkpatrick mana yang dibuktikan?
e: Level 4 mengukur dampak pelatihan pada tujuan organisasi, misalnya turunnya keluhan pelanggan.
q_en: After a customer-service training programme, the company's complaint rate falls 20%. Which Kirkpatrick level does this show?
e_en: Level 4 measures the impact of training on organisational goals, such as fewer customer complaints.
